notes.title: minor update for 9/25
notes.notes:
addresses the following issues:

*You can now move left/right after flight time ends from 4-3's star cannons
*Text has been revised to clarify the controls of starpole flight movement (point in the direction you want to go, NOT tank controls/rotational)
*Stage select allows faster scrolling by holding a direction
*Platforms were adjust in room 5 of 4-2 to make the intended solution more apparent

notes.title: NEXT FEST DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
NEXT FEST IS HERE!!!!! YO!!!!! VIDEOGAMES!!!!!

It's so exciting to share SomnaBuster with a new and growing community. To celebrate, I've updated the demo with all the quality of life changes from my most recent builds - AND, you can now play preview versions of Stage 2-1 and 3-1 from the final game! So even if you've already played the demo, there's all the more reason to go back :)

Metrics-wise, I'd also like to announce that SomnaBuster has over 500 wishlists! I'm extremely grateful for everyone's interest in the game!! But we're still fighting to get this number even higher - SO, PLEASE, share this game with your friends! Wishlist it, and tell them to wishlist it, too!

Thanks for so much support,

-PD (David)
